title: Цепная реакция разоблачений  (A Chain Reaction of Revelations)

segments.t: Devastated by what he just overheard, Max punches Kostya in the corridor as Nastya cries that Kostya betrayed her with Sasha. Trying to explain himself, Kostya accidentally blurts out 'And Kostya too'—revealing that Sasha had previously cheated on Max with Ilya as well.
Костя мне изменяет, он под Сашей.
Я давно тебе об этом хотел сказать.
Кто еще не переспал Саша, а?
Alright, let's go through it step by step in English.
'What was that for?' Barinov checks bluntly with Kostya now, pairing "za" ("for") with "chto" ("what") to get the point across in plain spoken Russian.
'He still has the nerve to ask what for?' Kostya tests openly in the room, combining "yeshche" ("still") and "sprashivayet" ("asks") so the key meaning lands right away.
Костя мне изменяет, он под Сашей.

'Kostya is cheating on me, he slept with Sasha.' Barinov takes a wry direction toward Kostya, weaving "izmenyayet" ("changes, alters") together with "kostya" ("Kostya") just the way native speakers do.
'Why are you all screaming out here?' Barinov questions firmly for Sasha's benefit, joining "orete" ("to yell, to bellow") to "vy" ("you") so every word pulls its weight.
'And Kostya too.' Sasha conveys a steady position straight away, weaving "tozhe" ("too") together with "kostya" ("Kostya") just the way native speakers do.
'I will explain everything right now.' Sasha presents a candid stance without hesitation, putting "seychas" ("now") alongside "obyasnyu" ("I'll explain") in a tight, everyday turn of phrase.
'What do you mean, 'too'?' Barinov inquires calmly for Kostya's benefit, building the phrase around "znachit" ("then, so") and "tozhe" ("too") for a crisp, natural delivery.
'No, not 'too'.' Kostya holds a brisk manner right away, pairing "tozhe" ("too") with "da" ("yes") to get the point across in plain spoken Russian.
'Sasha cheated on you with Ilya.' Barinov shows a steady tempo in this beat, using "izmenila" (from "izmenit", "would change") alongside "sasha" ("Sasha") to shape the meaning.
Я давно тебе об этом хотел сказать.
'I wanted to tell you about it a long time ago.' Barinov takes an honest posture as they talk, joining "davno" ("for a long time") to "khotel" ("wanted") so every word pulls its weight.
Кто еще не переспал Саша, а?
'Who else has not slept with Sasha yet, huh?' Kostya asks bluntly during the talk, putting "yeshche" ("still") alongside "perespal" ("to sleep overnight") in a tight, everyday turn of phrase.
'Chef, this bastard slept with Sasha.' Kostya offers a frank bearing in this beat, linking "kozel" ("goat"), "perespal" ("to sleep overnight"), and "shef" ("Chef") in one brisk exchange.
'It is the truth.' Barinov shows a brisk tone in front of Kostya, joining "pravda" ("honestly") to "eto" ("this") so every word pulls its weight.
Костя мне изменяет, он под Сашей.
Я давно тебе об этом хотел сказать.
Кто еще не переспал Саша, а?
That wraps up this scene as max punches Kostya in the corridor, and as Kostya tries to defend himself, he accidentally blurts out that Sasha had also cheated on Max with Ilya. Until next time!
